Ive had to get rid of so many avatars to make room for others and it sucks because I also collect brushes in VrChat and theres 11 of them which only gives me 5 spaces
each time I find a new avatar it's like I have to choose a child to sacrifice to make room

Iv always spoken to people in vrchat about this and they all do agree that there should be more than 16 slots. Like this isnt enough. its sad for people to remove good avatars to replace them for others.
i collect music avatars and this is painful to choose what music to get rid of all the time.

Opinion why to add more favorites:
- people get themselves lots of (potentially malicious) modifications. Either because of a higher moving speed/moving through walls, or much more likely because they want more avatars to choose from (these are usually the main two reasons) and represent themselves in a world differently. This risk would be reduced for many by increasing the number of favorites to pick from
- users will go to the worlds they need their avatars from, enabling people to have more favorites would spare them from this effort
- as mentioned above it is an unique characteristic for virtual reality not only to "feel" like being somewhere but also being some"thing" else, thereby being perceived as someone/something else by others and thereby hightening self-expression leading to conversations being much more interesting. Having less avatars to pick from for the many different worlds or occasions you can be in (especially when you are no avatar creator) can be very restrictive when it gets to that
- Throwing out favorites you really liked for other ones can make it almost impossible to find them ever again, for example if it is a public avatar made by only one person that hasnt been sharing it in a specific world
- Last but not least avatars are imo just as important as worlds, as they are kinda part of the world that is surrounding you, maybe even more so, since they help expressing what you feel, like or do directly, just like clothes do. A world is a much more neutral medium to be in, when everything is about chatting, which would be impossible without avatars to represent users, thereby making them more important to the concept of vrchat than worlds.
